_comment: This file is a Boost.Build test script with no importable functions, classes, or CLI-callable code. It only uses BoostBuild.Tester methods (write, run_build_system, expect_addition, cleanup) to test duplicate file staging across two projects. No standalone APIs exist to describe.
run_duplicate_stage_test: run the boost build test that stages the same file from two different projects to the same location
test_boostbuild_tester_write: test the BoostBuild Tester write method that creates test files like a.cpp and jamfile.jam
test_boostbuild_tester_run_build_system: test the BoostBuild Tester run_build_system method that executes the build
test_boostbuild_tester_expect_addition: test the BoostBuild Tester expect_addition method that verifies a file was created in the dist directory
test_boostbuild_tester_cleanup: test the BoostBuild Tester cleanup method that removes test artifacts after the test completes
